# Domain-Specific Agent Harness Spec

> Draft 0.1. Inventory the organization’s apps with a domain specialist and map their records to an ontology. Custom apps read and chart the mapped data. Agents read and update authorized apps or shared records while the team runs a goal on its harness. Specialist approvals and corrections provide evidence for reviewed improvements to definitions and evals.

- [Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gabriel-Operator/domain-specific-agent-harness-spec/main/README.md): How personas, runtimes, and harnesses fit together.
- [Homepage story](https://gabriel-operator.github.io/domain-specific-agent-harness-spec/#why-a-domain-specific-harness): Why a team needs shared rules and how a domain-specific harness carries a goal from plan to published records.
- [Specification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gabriel-Operator/domain-specific-agent-harness-spec/main/src/content/docs/specification.mdx): Folder structure, SKILL.md, definitions-only rule, resource keys, registry, and runtime rules.
- [Implementation guide](https://gabriel-operator.github.io/domain-specific-agent-harness-spec/implementation/): Map the architecture to definition files, workspace behavior, and validated example JSON.
- [Apps and connectors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gabriel-Operator/domain-specific-agent-harness-spec/main/src/content/docs/apps.mdx): Connector requirements, steps, lists, pipelines, app packages, live sync, and presence.
- [Concept reference](https://gabriel-operator.github.io/domain-specific-agent-harness-spec/concepts/): Individual concept pages covering core definitions, execution and governance, data and integrations, and infrastructure and distribution.
- [Governed execution](https://gabriel-operator.github.io/domain-specific-agent-harness-spec/concepts/governed-execution/): Human decisions, isolated rehearsal, exact effect approval, and live receipts.
- [Skill catalogue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gabriel-Operator/domain-specific-agent-harness-spec/main/src/content/docs/skills.mdx): Individual Gabriel Operator skills and child references.
- [Examples](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gabriel-Operator/domain-specific-agent-harness-spec/main/src/content/docs/examples.mdx): Studio tour, a prospect workflow, and 17 persona architectures.
- [Terms and standards](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Gabriel-Operator/domain-specific-agent-harness-spec/main/src/content/docs/standards.mdx): Terminology, Agent Skills, MCP, A2A, and the Standard Agent Specification.

- [Agent Skills specification](https://agentskills.io/specification): Format for the root SKILL.md and bundled skills.
